text: In March of 2015, fifty-three of us said "of homeland security," peaking on the third; Richard J. Durbin said it first. That same day, thirty-one of us said "fund the department." Later in the month our record turns to health. On the twenty-sixth, thirty-five of us said "health insurance program," thirty-three said "community health centers," and thirty of us said "chip reauthorization act," first said by Richard E. Neal. Twenty-nine of us said "medicare access and"; twenty-eight said "and chip reauthorization act"; twenty-seven of us said "medicare access and chip reauthorization act." Two convergences, then: a department at the start of the month, a set of health programs at its end. We recorded ourselves saying the same phrases within the same days. This is what the record from March 2015 shows of us.

top_phrases.phrase: medicare access and chip reauthorization act
